cio_explain: CIO-A (institutional) forecasts from business evidence (company results, deals, order books, sector state) and the market context; CIO-B is a statistical model that uses price data only; CIO-C (hybrid) uses the same business evidence plus CIO-B's price model.
forward_only_note: Forward results only. Historical School replay results are kept separately and are not shown here.
notice: Experimental research. Not investment advice. Not a guarantee of returns.

down.name: Persistent Systems
down.reason: Price-pattern model (price data only). Strongest signals: distance below the 1-year high (pushes towards DOWN), 20-day return versus IT peers (pushes towards DOWN).

up.name: KPIT Technologies
up.reason: Price-pattern model (price data only). Strongest signals: distance below the 1-year high (pushes towards UP), 20-day return versus IT peers (pushes towards DOWN).

rules.agreement: number of CIOs whose recorded direction for the same stock and horizon matches; not a probability
rules.display_pct: 100 x recorded directional probability (UP: p_up; DOWN: 1 - p_up), rounded half-up
rules.price_model_picks: the highest-ranked UP and DOWN cells of CIO-B only (price data only)
rules.ranking: recorded directional probability, then CIO A/B/C, then horizon, then symbol
rules.research_picks: the highest-ranked UP and DOWN cells of CIO-A and CIO-C only; reason = the first sentence of that CIO's own recorded rationale
rules.result: settled outcome only (matured window): base-session open to the close of session base+h-1, split/bonus adjusted; ABSTAIN is not a call
rules.top_list: the next highest-ranked cells of all CIOs, excluding the four picks

stale_label: Latest available forecast (no newer forecast has been frozen)
